original.target_description: Primary article verified by title and DOI. No study, outcome, exposure, sample, or test locator supplied: description and study_o are null, locators_o is empty. Multiple eligible tests in Tables 3–5; correspondence to audit_id 2140 cannot be established.

n.sample_role: Unassigned candidates: 3934 women currently in union (Table 3); 4409 women ever-in-union (Tables 4 and 5). These are model/table sample sizes, not the recruitment total of 6540.
n.exclusions: Table 3 excludes separated, divorced, and widowed women because timing of union dissolution or spouse death is unavailable; Table 5 uses women ever in union. No target-specific sample selected.
n.location: pp. 1656–1658, Analytic approach and Tables 3–5 footnotes
n.quote: N ¼ 3934 (women currently in union). ... N ¼ 4409 (women ever-in-union).

notes: Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders. No target inferred from audit identifier, row order, or numeric matching. PDF pages 5–7 (printed pp. 1657–1659) rendered and inspected; canonical text is the evidence source. Table 3 contains adjusted ORs for emotional, physical, and sexual IPV as outcomes among currently-in-union women (N=3934); Table 4 contains bivariate CMD/suicidal-ideation percentages and p values, not printed ORs; Table 5 contains multiple ORs for CMD risk and suicidal ideation among ever-in-union women (N=4409). Table 5 metric is explicitly ORs based on Y*-standardized coefficients; no conversion performed. Table 5 printed IPV candidates in column order CMD Model 1, CMD Model 3, suicidal ideation Model 1, suicidal ideation Model 3: {"Last 12 months: emotional": ["1.64***", "1.58***", "1.42*", "1.32y"], "Last 12 months: physical": ["1.26*", "1.17y", "2.05***", "1.86***"], "Last 12 months: sexual": ["1.60***", "1.47**", "1.51*", "1.43*"], "More than 12 months ago only: emotional": ["1.36***", "1.32***", "1.28", "1.18"], "More than 12 months ago only: physical": ["1.21*", "1.14", "1.11", "1.05"], "More than 12 months ago only: sexual": ["1.39**", "1.25*", "1.58**", "1.39*"]}. Same-test printed legend: *** p<0.001; ** p<0.01; * p<0.05; y (PDF dagger) p<0.10; unmarked entries have no printed coefficient p bound. These are candidates, not an assigned effect. Other covariate ORs and model-fit tests also occur; absence of a locator prevents narrowing to an IPV coefficient or choosing any other row. Table 4 past emotional/suicidal p=0.799 and past physical/suicidal p=0.293 are bivariate tests and must not be combined with Table 5 ORs. No arithmetic N sum performed. Model Ns retained only as candidates for field-scope review.
